newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: Lithuanian shares gain, Rokishkis up on results.
newsitem.headline: Lithuanian shares gain, Rokishkis up on results.

text.p: Lithuanian shares gained slightly on Thursday as the sleepy market finally reacted to key blue chip results, dealers said.
The blue-chip official list marched up 5.35 points to 950.15 points while the broader group A index rose 5.83 points to 1830.29 points in central market turnover of 505,000 litas.
Rokishkis Cheese, which on Monday announced its interim 1997 profits grew to 9.467 million litas from 1.253 million litas in the same period last year, advanced to 43.00 litas from 41.50.
"It is definitely the market's delayed reaction to its good results," said one broker. "I think that the price will continue to grow."
Recent market favourite Hermis Bank remained steady at 215 litas amid central market turnover of 77,000 litas.
Hermis turned over 255,000 litas in block trades at prices between 212 and 213 litas.
"Hermis shares are still active but their prices have stabilised for the time being since the prices in block trades were lower than on the central market," one dealer said.
The broker said he expected Hermis prices to start growing in about a month.
Shares in Lithuanian Sea Shipping Company (LISCO) edged up to 5.68 litas from 5.63 litas. Brokers say LISCO is going through a recovery after an earlier slide.
"I think the previous price was too low for one of the most liquid shares on the Vilnius bourse," one broker said. "I expect it to climb to 5.80 litas."
